t: This is Grosvenor Gardens House, a Grade II listed mansion block at 23 to 47 Grosvenor Gardens, in Belgravia. It was designed by Thomas Cundy the Third, who was surveyor of the Grosvenor Estate until he retired in 1890. The building has some famous names attached. The actor David Niven was born here in 1910, and the Queen Mother may have been born here too, in 1900. A sadder note is that William Henry Blackmore took his own life here in 1878.
